name: CDN edge
oneLine: Keeps copies of pages and files in cities near your users, so most requests never travel to your servers.
useWhen: Your users are far from your servers.
Most responses are the same for everyone: pages, images, scripts.
You want your servers to see only the requests nobody has made before.
watchOut: A copy can outlive the content: purge on change, or users see old prices.
Personal pages must never be cached at the edge.
A purge sends a burst of misses to the origin.

numbers.label: Round trip to an edge in your city
